newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases on thin demand for KCB.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases on thin demand for KCB.

text.p: A drop in foreign demand for leading Kenya Commercial Bank dragged the the Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index down 11.96 points on Monday to close at 3253.36, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 13.952 million shillings on 351,998 shares compared to 17.776 million shillings on 480,488 shares.
Kenya Commercial Bank lost 12.50 to close at 77.50, its lowest price this year.
"I believe the lower market price will attract buyers," a senior broker said, predicting the price might rise again -- but this time to 85-shilling levels.
Shares across the board held steady in lacklustre trading.
Barclays Bank closed at 101 from 100 while Standard Chartered Bank edged to 43 from 42.50.
Among agriculturals, Rea Vipingo traded at 9.15 from 9.10 while Sasini Tea & Coffee eased to 76.50 from 78. Kenya Airways was unchanged at 8.10 while Uchumi Supermarket eased to 37.25 from 38.
Total Kenya closed at 636 unchanged while Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 122.
